title: Accept Proposal - Submitted
description: Bounded submitted task envelope for accept_proposal. Adds the optional expected_confirmation_at estimate for confirmations tied to a scheduled event.

expected_confirmation_at.description: Optional estimate of when the seller expects to confirm this request, used when confirmation depends on a scheduled event such as a booking round or a manual review window. A seller SHOULD set it when it knows that event; omit it when it does not. Buyers SHOULD schedule a status check (get_task_status, or reconciling against the webhook) for this time rather than polling tightly before it. This is an estimate, not a commitment: the seller MAY confirm earlier or later, the task status remains authoritative, and buyers MUST NOT treat a passed timestamp as a failure or auto-cancel on it. Sellers SHOULD NOT send a timestamp in the past. Not an expiry or SLA.
